description: Election Commission - Mr. T. L. K. D. Jayasekara of the Kirinda Puhulwella Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of that P/S - Mr. M. A. L. Madhushanka of the Kataragama P/S has vacated his office of the member of that P/S
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas due to ceasing to be members of their political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters such as candidate registrations, vacating of offices, and electoral commission decisions.
